The following graph represents the T-V curves of an ideal gas (where T is the temperature and V the
volume) at three pressures P1, P2 and P3 compared with those of Charles’s law represented as
dotted lines. Then the correct relation is:
(1)
P3 > P2 > P1
(2)
P1 > P3 > P2
(3)
P2 > P1 > P3
(4)
P1 > P2 > P3
